1.1.1: Apply configurable baseUrl to all auth methods.
1.1.3: Added customFields in CreateContact and updateContact.
1.2.1: Support for custom objects. Added generic components: ListObjects, GetObjectFields, CreateObjectRecord, GetObjectRecord, UpdateObjectRecord, DeleteObjectRecord and Query. 'Record' is either standard SalesForce object or Custom object.
1.2.2: Fields generated for CreateObjectRecord and UpdateObjectRecord are now cached for 5 minutes before refreshed.
1.3.2: New Trigger: Updated Opportunity - triggers when an Opportunity changes to a specified stage.
New Action: Get Profile Info - Gets the current user's profile information.
1.3.3: New Lead, Create Lead, Update Lead - enhance the output schema.
1.3.4: Added output examples to component schemas.
1.4.0: Added test() (Flow Test Mode) to all triggers: NewContact, NewEvent, NewLead, NewOpportunity, UpdatedOpportunity.
1.5.0: Added MakeApiCall component for performing arbitrary authorized API calls to the Salesforce API.
1.6.0: New Trigger: Lead Status Change - triggers with the lead details when the Status (or another chosen field) changes on a Lead.
New Trigger: Contact Status Change - triggers when a chosen status field changes on a specific Contact or on any Contact.
New Trigger: Account Status Change - triggers with the account details when a chosen status field changes on an Account.
New Trigger: Record Field Change - triggers when a chosen field changes on any record of a selected object (standard or custom).
1.7.0: New Action: Get Contacts (FindContacts) - returns all contacts, optionally scoped to a single account, with their related contact information; emits to a notFound port when nothing matches.

New Action: Get Contacts by Field (FindContactsByField) - returns all contacts matching a chosen Contact field value (for example a Campaign ID, Account or custom field); emits to a notFound port when nothing matches.
Create Contact: the Account and Reports To dropdowns now accept variables and manual input (typeahead instead of a fixed select), and the output fields carry examples for the variable picker.
List Accounts: dynamic-input (dropdown) source calls are now cached for 5 minutes, matching Get Object Fields, to conserve the Salesforce request quota.
Create Contact: Account is now optional (Salesforce only requires Last Name; contacts without an account are valid private contacts).

Update Contact: the Contact, Account and Reports To dropdowns now accept variables and manual input (typeahead), Contact ID is validated, and the output fields carry examples for the variable picker. Assigning/moving a contact to an account works by setting Account on Update Contact.
New Actions: Create Account and Delete Account - create an account (name, industry, billing address, parent account picker, ...) and delete an account by ID (account picker).

Get Contacts by Field: new Match Type input - Exact match (default), Contains and Starts with; the latter two use a SOQL LIKE query on text fields, with LIKE wildcards in the value escaped so it always matches literally.

Get Contacts: new optional Campaign filter - returns only contacts that are members of the selected campaign (Campaign History; SOQL semi-join via CampaignMember), combinable with the Account filter. New action List Campaigns powers the campaign dropdown (cached source calls).

Review fixes: dropdown source calls now actually pass isSource/variableFetch so caching and error suppression apply; Get Contacts by Field exact match emits unquoted SOQL literals for boolean/number/date fields (validated, injection-safe) and includes the filtered field in the output; contact outputs no longer carry the REST attributes envelope (fixes CSV file mode); SOQL escaping covers backslashes; CreateAccount stores explicit 0 values; token-import profileInfo fallback guards missing userinfo claims.

List Campaigns is a standard List action (Output Type array/object/file with a working output schema in the variable picker). Status-change/RecordFieldChange triggers: record output sources drop ignoreAuth (live describe needs the bound account; fixes 'Invalid URL' variable pickers), describe calls are cached, and field/object dropdowns accept manual input (typeahead).
